description: Frozen multi-turn GSM8K validation snapshot; training accuracy is final-episode success within at most two attempts.

setup.noise: Fixed delta = 0.02 * initial_weight * Normal(0,1), added to current sampler weights; trainer and evaluation weights unperturbed.
setup.objective: Same REINFORCE + token TIS objective in both arms; control zeros only the score-centering correction. Binary correctness mapped to -1/+1 before within-prompt mean subtraction.

limitations: One seed and controlled sampler-weight mismatch.
Math retry task; does not measure tool-task learning.
SC also loses accuracy late in training.
Long runs precede the rebase; current PR regression tests are separate.
